warranty also reduces the cost of EVs. Additionally, providing a low-price battery for aftermarket extends

The role of first-life EV battery extension is moving to the forefront to combat current raw material shortages

best interests as battery recycling systems evolve and mature. After all, climate change waits for no one and

The Basics of EV Battery Structure
In general, EV batteries are composed of 
cells. A cluster of cells makes up a module, 
and a cluster of modules make up a pack. 
Ultimately the pack is installed in an EV. 
An EV module has cells welded or otherwise 
physically attached to each other. Multiple 
battery cells are assembled into a module, 
wrapped in steel plates, and have their poles 
welded together to produce the correct 
voltage. Normally, around 12 cells go into a 
conventional battery module for EVs.

practice. But countries that can reclaim valuable minerals and metals from spent batteries can lessen their

provides an additional $60 million to support the reuse and recycling of used EV batteries. However, the
